drives: The RVND engine's ingest/validate path when present; otherwise DELEGATES the lowering to the free loomground plane skills and assembles their output into one dimensioned Subgraph. Delegates; never regrows a lowering.
grounding: ../../references/ingest-cascade.md — verified this session: GovernanceIngester/DeonticIngester lower policy text to a Subgraph (dimension nD, edges on the 5 axes); ALLOWED_FACETS={5D,nD}; LLM enrichment yields a valid loomground_norm.DeonticFormula in-grammar; governance patch validates against schema('patch')
cascade: local-first: RVND engine lowering when present (precise, signable); else DELEGATE to the plane skills (loomground-ingest + deontic + loomground) + in-grammar enrichment (coarse, advisory) — never the reverse
invariants: one object — produces the shared dimensioned Subgraph; never a hand-built .lg patch or bespoke shape

delegate, don't regrow — the lowering belongs to the free plane skills (loomground-ingest, deontic, loomground); this skill assembles and enriches their output, never re-authors it; a meaning with no construct becomes a visible residual, never an invented one
cascade local-first — the engine's lowering wins when present; the LLM path is the labelled fallback
enrichment stays in-grammar — the LLM corrects fields into valid plane objects (e.g. DeonticFormula), never a new shape, so an engine ingesting the fallback graph later sees the same object
never applies — onboarding ends at a validated graph + residuals; applying/signing is sign-off + the engine
consumes governance + deontic + legal + norm (+ factual + epistemic) into one graph
degraded mode is labelled — standalone builds carry no solver/versum precision and no signature, and say so
provenance: Authored for loomground; drives the AGPL-3.0-only RVND server and consumes the loomground planes. Grounded in a running-code survey of the ingest/norm/legal planes. No third-party skill source.
notes: Reference implementation of the ingest-cascade architecture; the pattern the other user-action skills follow. Merges the former extract-policy-norms + compile-loomground-policy pipeline steps into one user action, and delegates the lowering to the free loomground plane skills.
review: Architecture proven in running code; registered in package.json as one of the 8 user-action skills; delegates to the free plane skills (loomground-ingest/deontic/loomground). Landing via PR against main.
